short_description: A soft talk-along cloth book for ages 0–1: crinkle, soft and bumpy pages, a safety mirror and bold black-and-white first pages. Design preview only.
long_description:
Soft! Bumpy! Crinkle! is a talk-along cloth book for ages 0–1, made for the first year of laps, looks and back-and-forth. It has six soft pages, each with one first word and one short grown-up tip.

The first pages are bold ink-and-white pictures, a smiling face and a checkered frame, that are easy to look at together up close. Then come the pages to touch: a crinkle page to scrunch, a soft patch to stroke, a bumpy shell to tap, and a safety mirror page for a 'who's that?' moment. The last page waves bye-bye.

Every tip is one small thing to try: say hi close up and wait, look in the mirror together, crinkle and pause, say what you feel, name it as you touch, wave and wait. A look, a coo or a kick counts as your baby's turn.

This is a design preview. The book is not for sale yet. A cloth book has to be sewn in a factory run and safety-tested by an independent lab, and we will only take orders once that is done. It has no buttons, no loose parts and no glass. Talk, sign, sing and read in the language you know best.

compliance_notes: DESIGN ONLY, HELD FROM SALE. Children's product and soft toy for under-3s: needs CPSIA third-party testing at a CPSC-accepted lab (lead, phthalates, small parts after use-and-abuse, sharp points and edges, flammability as applicable, ASTM F963 cord/loop and stuffing rules; UNVERIFIED), a Children's Product Certificate, a permanent sewn-in tracking label and packaging marks, care and fibre-content labelling, and EU toy-safety (EN 71-1/-2/-3, CE, responsible person) plus GPSR compliance for any EU sale (all UNVERIFIED; MANUFACTURING.md). Safety design: no detachable parts, no buttons, no cords; ribbon tabs are closed loops at least 0.6 in wide, ends sealed inside the seam, sticking out 1 in or less; every seam and appliqué double lockstitched; the mirror is flexible safety mirror film with enclosed edges, never glass or rigid acrylic; crinkle film fully enclosed. A check-before-each-play line is on the back cover. No health, development, vision or learning claims: the high-contrast pages are described only as bold pictures to look at together (hard rule 1); no condition or diagnosis is named or targeted. Talk strategies in plain words, no trademarked program names (rule 6). 'Talk, sign, sing and read in the language you know best' and 'Version 1.0 · September 2026' are on the back cover (rules 15 and 3). No hook-and-loop, flaps or glued parts (rules 8 and 20). faq.q: Can I buy this cloth book?
faq.a: Not yet. This is a design preview. A cloth book is sewn in a factory run and has to pass independent safety testing before anyone can buy it. We will only take orders once that is done.

faq.q: Why isn't it printed on demand?
faq.a: Nobody prints sewn cloth books with a mirror and a crinkle page one at a time. It needs a factory run, lab testing and a warehouse, so it waits until we can do all of that properly.
Ages 0–1, played with a grown-up close by. The first pages are bold black-and-white pictures to look at together; the touch pages are for reaching, scrunching and patting.

Six soft pages with one word each: hi, look, crinkle, soft, bumpy and bye-bye. There's a crinkle page, a soft patch, a bumpy patch, a safety mirror and three ribbon tabs, plus one short grown-up tip on every page.
No. It's a flexible safety mirror film, never glass, with its edges sewn inside a fabric frame.

faq.q: Are there buttons or small parts?
faq.a: No buttons, beads, snaps, squeakers or hook-and-loop. The ribbon tabs are short closed loops sewn into the seam. Check the seams, tabs and mirror before each play, and stop using the book if anything is loose or torn.

faq.q: Will the black-and-white pages help my baby's eyes or brain?
faq.a: We don't make claims like that. They're bold pictures that are easy to look at together up close, and a nice place to say hi and wait for a look back.
The care label will give the exact instructions once the fabric is tested. We plan for surface washing or a cold hand wash and air drying flat.

faq.q: How will I know when it's available?
faq.a: Join the free email list at playbeforepixels.com. We'll only announce it once testing is done and a ship date is real.
